fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled truck gate confirmed at the SW-end entrance: a guard-booth island where the access road narrows and splits, with an orange/yellow barrier-arm/gate object visible on the lane in zoom-21 satellite. Street View (2023-01) shows perimeter fencing, an 'ATTENTION' sign and a '10 mph' speed sign at the entrance. Web driver review explicitly cites 'security and receiving personnel'.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small square guard-booth building (~1-2 vehicle footprint) with a flagpole and an attached canopy/awning, sitting on a triangular island in the truck lane — classic gatehouse, separate from the main building.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — a staffed guard shack is present.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved apron inside the gate before the dock banks provides truck holding/queue space.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large dedicated trailer-storage rows on the NE side and along the SE face — clearly drop-trailer storage separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors run along both long faces (NW and SE) — two distinct dock banks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~150 doors estimated across both long faces; large high-throughput RDC.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron and truck yard with abundant unused paved width for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound; the road splits around the booth island. No painted lane control, count approximate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural McCalla AL industrial park with surrounding woodland and a rail line alongside; Rural per rubric.
